children: Mynt, the parent of Philippine mobile wallet operator GCash, said on Friday it has priced its initial public offering at 6.60 Philippine pesos ($0.1052) a share, or about 53 billion pesos in total, in what would be one of the country's biggest listings.
The announcement confirms a Reuters report on Thursday that the company would price the IPO at that level. Mynt operates GCash, a Philippine digital wallet and financial services platform.
